summary: This Form 6-K filed by Magnum Ice Cream Co N.V. is a routine disclosure under UK/EU Market Abuse Regulation detailing share acquisitions by PDMRs Ronald Schellekens, Mustafa Seckin, and Toloy Tahir Tanridagli on June 1-2, 2026. Transactions were executed on CBOE, LSE, NYSE, and Amsterdam exchanges at prices ranging from €13.58 to £12.295 and $16.6864 per share, totaling ~GBP 399,992, EUR 239,275, and USD 300,656. No special situation event is present; it is a standard insider-trading notification for a foreign private issuer.
